# RaphaAtlas

> Evidence-based health, fitness, and nutrition — with free clinical calculators.
> A project of Growth Partners Global LLC. Health content reviewed by MBBS physicians.

## Calculators
- [Body Type Calculator](https://www.raphaatlas.com/body-type-calculator/): Find your somatotype (ectomorph, mesomorph, endomorph).
- [Macro Calculator](https://www.raphaatlas.com/macro-calculator/): Daily protein, carbohydrate, and fat targets.
- [BAC Calculator](https://www.raphaatlas.com/bac-calculator/): Estimate blood alcohol concentration (Widmark method).
- [Conception Calculator](https://www.raphaatlas.com/conception-calculator/): Estimate conception and due dates.

## Content
- [Fitness](https://www.raphaatlas.com/fitness/): Strength, conditioning, recovery.
- [Nutrition](https://www.raphaatlas.com/nutrition/): Macros, micronutrients, eating patterns.
- [Health](https://www.raphaatlas.com/health/): Conditions, biomarkers, preventive care.

## Trust
- [Medical Review Board](https://www.raphaatlas.com/medical-review-board/): Reviewing physicians (MBBS).
- [Editorial Policy](https://www.raphaatlas.com/editorial-policy/): How content is researched, reviewed, corrected.
- [About](https://www.raphaatlas.com/about/)
- [Contact](https://www.raphaatlas.com/contact/)
